sections.heading: MAJOR IN GLOBAL DEVELOPMENT
lines: Centre for Global Social Innovation - Faculty of Arts and Social Science

Completion of first-year requirements, including at least 1.0 essay course, satisfied with either two half–year courses or one full–year course, with a mark of at least 60%. Anthropology, Centre for Global Social Innovation, Economics, English, Gender, Sexuality, and Women's Studies, Geography and Environment, History, Indigenous Studies, Media and Communication Studies, Philosophy, Political Science, Social Justice and Peace Studies, and Sociology are recommended as first year courses.
1.5 courses from: GSI 3509F/G, GSI 3512F/G, GSI 3518F/G, GSI 3527F/G, GSI 3532F/G.

1.0 course from: GSI 3000-4999 level; or non–GSI course at the 2200 level or higher from Arts and Humanities, Social Science, or Information and Media Studies that engages directly with Global Development content, as approved by the Centre for Global Social Innovation.
